meta.name: D2
meta.shortDescription: Run a D2 testnet node on your dogebox
meta.longDescription: This pup launches a D2 testnet node on your dogebox. The D2 testnet is reset every two weeks from a Dogecoin (D1) chainstate snapshot, enabling stress test scenarios against a realistic UTXO set.

permissionGroups.name: RPC
permissionGroups.description: Allows RPC access to the D2 node

permissionGroups.name: Events
permissionGroups.description: Allows access to D2 node block/transaction event notifications

permissionGroups.name: Network
permissionGroups.description: Allows access to the D2 node's network port

metrics.name: status
metrics.label: Status
metrics.description: Whether the D2 node is running

metrics.name: chain
metrics.label: Chain
metrics.description: Network the D2 node is on

metrics.name: blocks
metrics.label: Block Height
metrics.description: Current D2 block height

metrics.name: headers
metrics.label: Headers
metrics.description: Number of block headers the D2 node has seen

metrics.name: testnet_epoch
metrics.label: Testnet Epoch
metrics.description: Current testnet epoch (chain ID); changes when the testnet is reset from a fresh D1 snapshot

metrics.name: peers
metrics.label: Peers
metrics.description: Number of peers connected to the D2 node

metrics.name: mempool_txs
metrics.label: Mempool Txs
metrics.description: Number of transactions waiting in the D2 mempool

metrics.name: finality_lag
metrics.label: Finality Lag (blocks)
metrics.description: Blocks between the chain tip and the last finalized block

metrics.name: last_block
metrics.label: Last Finalized Block
metrics.description: Hash of the last finalized D2 block

metrics.name: validators
metrics.label: Validators
metrics.description: Number of active validators on the D2 testnet

metrics.name: view
metrics.label: View
metrics.description: Current consensus view number reported by the D2 node. Advances as validators rotate leadership; a rapidly climbing view without new blocks indicates consensus problems.

metrics.name: last_finalized_age
metrics.label: Finalized Age (s)
metrics.description: Seconds since the last block was finalized. Continuously growing values mean the chain has stopped finalizing new blocks.

metrics.name: total_tickets
metrics.label: Total Tickets
metrics.description: Total staked validator tickets in the current validator set, from d2_getValidatorSet.

metrics.name: d1_tip
metrics.label: D1 Tip
metrics.description: Current Dogecoin (D1) chain tip height reported by core RPC

metrics.name: d1_height
metrics.label: D1 Followed Height
metrics.description: The d2-node d1follow module's ingest checkpoint: the last D1 block height durably applied to the migration index (d2_d1_height)

metrics.name: d1_blocks_total
metrics.label: D1 Blocks Ingested
metrics.description: Total D1 blocks the d2-node follower has ingested from the follow directory (d2_d1_blocks_total)

metrics.name: d1_blocks_written
metrics.label: D1 Blocks Written
metrics.description: Raw D1 block files the d1follower service has dropped into the follow directory since it started

metrics.name: d1_pending
metrics.label: D1 Blocks Pending
metrics.description: Block files waiting in the follow directory (the node deletes each file once durably applied)

metrics.name: d1_follow_lag
metrics.label: D1 Follow Lag (blocks)
metrics.description: Confirmed D1 height minus the follower's ingest checkpoint (0 when caught up)

metrics.name: d1_migration_candidates
metrics.label: Migration Candidates
metrics.description: Tier-B migration candidates derived from followed D1 blocks (d2_d1_migration_candidates)

metrics.name: d1_utxo_spent_total
metrics.label: D1 UTXOs Spent
metrics.description: Spent-on-D1 markers recorded in the migration index from followed blocks (d2_d1_utxo_spent_total)

metrics.name: d1_mempool_txs
metrics.label: D1 Mempool Txs
metrics.description: Unconfirmed transactions in the D1 (core) mempool available for relay

metrics.name: d1_relayed_total
metrics.label: D1 Txs Relayed
metrics.description: Unconfirmed D1 transactions the d1mempool service has relayed into the D2 mempool (wrapped by the node as D1Relay transactions)

metrics.name: d1_relay_pending
metrics.label: D1 Txs Pending Relay
metrics.description: D1 mempool transactions not yet relayed to the D2 mempool

metrics.name: d1_relay_failed
metrics.label: D1 Relay Failures
metrics.description: Relay attempts rejected by the D2 node since the d1mempool service started
